name: Adventure in Russia: Road to Harvetsky
source:
The main character is the usual average schoolboy, who can be found on the street after the 7th lesson. But it's not so simple, because he has a dream inside of his head, a dream that you have to implement!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1072030/]Steam[/url]]
